purpose: Offline M8-ADM-01a3a rehearsal of the additive run-creation receipt schema against an older persisted production SQLite backup; this is not the pre-release production backup
method: Copy the verified pre-M5 SQLite backup into a 0700 temporary directory under the approved backup location, apply the current app.store.connect schema bootstrap to the copy, rerun it in a fresh Python process, inspect only schema metadata and row counts, then remove the temporary copy and WAL sidecars. This drill hashes the newline-joined non-null sqlite_master.sql statements ordered by type,name; the pre-M5 manifest did not define its schema-hash canonicalization, so only the full backup-file SHA-256 is compared with that manifest.
limits: The source backup predates M5; the new table still requires a fresh consistent production backup immediately before deploying the receipt schema. No private row content was printed or retained in this artifact.
